chapter_seo_title: The Rival’s Challenge – A Hundred-Eight Cloud Beasts Descend on Serpentwing Lake
chapter_meta_description: Chen Jin, Nine Lotos’s childhood friend, discovers her with Ji Ning on Serpentwing Lake. Enraged, he unleashes a hundred-eight cloud formation and challenges Ji Ning to a battle that will test pride, Dao-hearts, and the bonds of the Black-White College.
og_title: The Rival’s Challenge – A Hundred-Eight Cloud Beasts Descend on Serpentwing Lake
og_description: Chen Jin confronts Ji Ning and Nine Lotos on Serpentwing Lake. Rage transforms into an earth-shaking challenge as a hundred and eight cloud-beasts surround the sky. A classic Xianxia showdown between love and pride.
twitter_title: The Rival’s Challenge – Chen Jin vs Ji Ning
twitter_description: Childhood friend Chen Jin finds Nine Lotos with Ji Ning on Serpentwing Lake. Rage ignites, clouds transform into beasts, and a daring challenge is thrown—will Ji Ning answer?

lore_anchors.definition: The top third-generation disciple of the Black-White College, a Wanxiang Adept who has mastered a complete Dao and even defeated a Primal Daoist. He serves as a calm observer and the enforcer of sect rules during personal conflicts.
A cultivation partner bound by a shared Dao-heart and lifelong commitment; more than a romantic spouse, it signifies a union of two Dao paths that mutually elevate each other.
Ji Ning’s secluded home where his parents’ ashes were scattered; a sanctuary that symbolizes his emotional roots and has become a shared space with Nine Lotos.
The main settlement on Serpentwing Lake; home to the Ji Clan elders, Qiuye, and Ji Ning’s spirit-beasts.
The commandery where Chen Jin and Nine Lotos originally came from before relocating to Anchan City to join the Black-White College.
